caption: The drawing features a large, metallic ladle rendered in shades of gray and black, occupying the central and right portions of the image within a rectangular border. The ladle is shown in perspective, with its rounded bowl closer to the bottom right corner and its long, subtly curved handle arching upwards toward the top left. Above and to the left of the main perspective view, there is a top-down view of the ladle’s bowl, depicted as a shaded oval shape with a short, widening neck connecting to the handle. To the right of the central ladle, an outline drawing shows the handle from above, featuring a pattern of concentric ovals and interlacing loops running down the length of the handle. In the bottom left quadrant, a rectangular insert shows a simple outline of the ladle’s side profile, capturing only the handle’s curve and part of the bowl. The background is a pale off-white, and the lines and shading are done in pencil or graphite, giving the drawing a monochromatic appearance. There are a few small brownish stains on the paper, and the artist's signature, "Eugene F. Barsal," appears at the lower right corner within the main rectangular border.
title: Silver Gravy Ladle
